main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: A spectacular stay amongst the treetops with exceptional comfort. Our Jungle House is marvellously hidden away from the noisy part of town. All staff members were a delight, providing easy information and service throughout. We cannot recommend this stay enough!

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: One of the most beautiful and unique places we've ever stayed. We stayed two nights at the Happy Nest, which sits along the Sok river. We were in awe of the beauty of the surroundings and the density of the jungle. If you are a lover of nature and rainforests, this is a must. We'll be back!

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: It was like a dream come true to fall asleep in a treehouse to the sounds of nature. So beautiful and calm with plenty of opportunities to go on excursions. The rafting was awesome and the river is nice for a refreshing swim. Particularly enjoyed the vibe in the bar for a quiet drink and some good music.

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: Sleeping in the jungle is exciting! The bungalows are comfy and clean. The food was delicious and they made all Thai dishes vegan at our request. The staff were very nice, and went out of their way to help us. Thank you, Khao Sok National Park was an experience that we will never forget!

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: One day we found ourselves surrounded by playful monkeys outside our bungalow! It was magical to watch them swing through the branches, and even more exciting to capture a few photos from our balcony. Our room was comfortable and clean, blending perfectly with the jungle atmosphere.

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: The tree houses were a complete experience! Surrounded by the jungle and yet still cozy and welcoming. The staff were brilliant. Nothing was ever too much effort and they went out of their way to assist in whatever was needed. I cannot recommend it enough!!! Thank you so much.

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: Stunning jungle treehouses. We had monkeys playing right outside our room and the river to swim in right behind us. Incredibly coloured birds flying around. The food and drinks were great, and the service was friendly. The tours were very organized with great guides and transportation.

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: Great experience in an amazing place ! We've enjoyed staying in the middle of the jungle, The rooms are truly amazing! The hotel is made to make the experience unique while totally respecting the environment and nature: you adapt, not the other way around! Would love to go back.

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: Unique and experienced This was one of the coolest and most unique stays I've ever done. The fact that these folks have been doing this for 30 years really shows through. All of the staff were incredibly friendly and hospitable the whole time. The variety of activities were really nice. The Khao Sok Lake trip is a must-do.

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: Stay in the original Khao Sok treehouse resort, with unique jungle treehouses and bungalows set in the rainforest of Khao Sok National Park. See and hear the beat of the forest from your balcony - perfect for nature lovers.
Book your room and organize your own personalized experience

secondary_content.text: You can choose your accommodation, join guided jungle activities, or book a complete Khao Sok tour package.

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: Our Jungle House is more than a place to stay - it is a long-standing eco-project supporting converation and local communities.
With us, you're part of something bigger. Learn more about how your stay supports our conservation and community projects.

main_topic.h_title: Here's how you make a difference
main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: Your stay directly supports guide training, scholarships, and environmental education for thousands of children. Specifically, we direct 15% of profits to Jungle Life Camp, the Andaman Center, and vocational training.

main_topic.main_title: Experience Khao Sok National Park with Our Jungle House

primary_content.text: For every night you spend with us, two local students are able to attend Jungle Life Camp - a nonprofit center teaching the next generation to take care of the environment.
Nature education for 4,026 kids in 2024
Conservation of endangered lowland forest
Kayak and guide training for local teenagers
Learning Center for 200 at-risk youth
